tasks.title: Session child cleanup
tasks.description: Unregister closed Present windows from the deck session graph and exclude them from directed sends so the UI and program state stay consistent.

tasks.title: End blank program state
tasks.description: Implement the directed blank/clear command for End and keep present state bookkeeping in sync so Start resumes from slide one after a blank.

tasks.title: Program thumbnail fidelity
tasks.description: Make the on-program preview reflect the actual Present payload, including blank after End, and move it under the presentation controls without breaking layout.

tasks.title: Theme persistence relaunch
tasks.description: Persist the chosen theme in a user-owned settings location and restore it before first paint across quit and relaunch while keeping live updates in sync.

tasks.title: Durable library storage
tasks.description: Move the default library to ~/.poster, migrate existing cwd SQLite or JSON data once, and support re-pointing settings without moving old data.

tasks.title: Home regression guard
tasks.description: Keep the Home route free of the Open Present CTA while preserving the deck-driven presenter flow and guarding against regressions in the launcher UX.

tasks.title: Test harness and CI
tasks.description: Add the required unit, integration, and smoke tests for the A-E defects and wire them into the PR pipeline so the next-cycle regressions stay caught.

tasks.title: Acceptance documentation sync
tasks.description: Update the canonical product and epic docs to match shipped behavior and keep the acceptance checklist aligned with runtime and packaging changes.
